simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲהָלִים (H174) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲהָלִים (ʼăhâlîym) means aloe wood (i.e. sticks) First listed occurrence: Num 24 6.

definitions.full: H174. ahalim III. [ אהל ] noun [masculine] odorific tree , aloe (?) (? loan-word from Sanskrit aguru , agaru , dialect aghil , compare Wilson Skr. Dict .; M. Müller in Pusey Daniel 2d ed. p. 647 f ; aloÎxylon agallochum (compare Sigismund Aromata, Leipz. 1884, p. 38 f, MV cite Kondracki Beitr. z. Kenntn. d. Aloe, Dorpat 1874 & Baer Reden III, 293 f ); others aloe succotrina (Schenkel BL , compare Di ad Num 24:6 ); Wetzst in De Song of Solomon 2d ed. 167 brings under I. אהל ; he proposes cardamum , Arabic from = little tents , from three-cornered shape of capsules) 1 plural אֲהָלִים trees planted by ׳י Num 24:6 (|| ארזים perhaps error for אֵילִים compare Di. 2 aloes , as sweet-smelling; perfume for bed, אֲהָלִים Prov 7:17 (|| קִנָּמוֺן מֹר, ); for garments אֲהָלוֺת Psa 45:9 (|| קְצִיעוֺת מֹר, ); of bride, under figure of odorific tree Song 4:14 (|| בְשָׂמִים כָּלרָֿאשֵׁי מֹר, ).
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) אֲהָלוֹת (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin;
